gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with newly diagnosed histologically confirmed GBM (WHO grade IV, IDH wild type) undergoing surgical resection;

candidate_evidence.quote: The aim of this study is to evaluate the effect of Metformin as adjuvant therapy to TMZ in the treatment of patients with GBM.
It allow us to determine the efficacy at the recommended dose (RD) of metformin in patients with GBM

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients with newly diagnosed histologically confirmed GBM (WHO grade IV, IDH wild type) undergoing surgical resection;

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Peri-operative plasma will be taken from each patient for hematochemical analysis, in order to research of prognostic biomarkers.

role_evidence.quote: Administration of the standard or partial Stupp protocol (Radiotherapy + Temozolomide) in combination with Metformin for 6 weeks,
Administration of the standard or partial Stupp protocol (Radiotherapy + Temozolomide) in combination with Metformin for 6 weeks,
Patients undergoing Stupp protocol including patients aged \> 70 years performing the hypofractionated protocol and three weeks of chemotherapy;

source_quote.quote: Patients with newly diagnosed histologically confirmed GBM (WHO grade IV, IDH wild type) undergoing surgical resection;
hypomethylation or hypermethylation of MGMT assessed post-surgery;

biomarkers.biomarker_other: tumour gene expression / transcriptomic molecular phenotype

source_quote.quote: Identifying the molecular phenotype of cells taken from patients' tissue samples during surgery and comparing clinical response and molecular phenotype by transcriptomic analysis

coder_notes: Metformin added to Stupp TMZ/RT; TMZ is not a registered intervention but every patient receives it per the Stupp protocol, so listed as soc_backbone. MGMT is in the inclusion list but either methylation status is allowed (status must only be assessed), so not coded as an eligibility selection; coded exploratory_correlative. Plasma metabolites, adiponectin and proteomics are described as prognostic biomarkers from peri-operative plasma, not explicitly linked to metformin's target, so target_engagement_planned unclear. In vitro patient-derived cell response is also an exploratory outcome. Escaped '\>' in eligibility quote is copied as it appears in the record.
